Samir — quick follow-up from compliance side. I reviewed the redlines and added a 1-page SLA carve-out summary (inline below) for scenarios where multi-region warm-cache restoration may exceed standard RTO (very rare, explicit condition sets listed).

SLA carve-outs summary (excerpt):
- Large-scale region-wide hardware failure with concurrent control-plane impact: contingency RTO up to 6 hours for full KV rehydration (we provide partial read-only endpoints within 60 minutes).
- Customer-managed private deployments: RTO subject to customer's network failover times; Redwood will provide restore guidance but cannot control third-party networking.

Next steps:
- Ben to confirm whether sanitized raw logs are required (we can provide both sanitized and full with access controls).
- Laura to add the signature page for the evidence index (attestation).

Samir, if that carve-out language works for Aurora's audit, we'll finalize the CSV and push the manifest to your S3 link. If not, propose edits and we can iterate quickly.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
